200.title: Defence-less Ukraine will result in drones reaching Poland, warns Polish defence minister
200.summary: Poland’s Deputy Prime Minister and Defence Minister, Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz , warned that inadequate air defence systems and interceptor ammunition for Ukraine increase the military threat to Poland.
200.body: Poland’s Deputy Prime Minister and Defence Minister, Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz , warned that inadequate air defence systems and interceptor ammunition for Ukraine increase the military threat to Poland. He stated in parliament that insufficient support for Ukraine’s air defences raises security risks for Poland, especially after recent incidents where Polish planes were shot down during Russian attacks. We monitored the threats, scrambled aviation—including allied forces—and were ready to respond and defend Poland,” said the Polish defence minister. “If Ukraine lacks air defences, many of these drones will reach Poland.” His comments followed a speech by Sławomir Mentzen , a leader of the right-wing extremist Confederation party, an ally of the Alternative for Germany (AfD), who criticised the Polish armed forces for shortages in artillery ammunition and insufficient civil defence infrastructure.

300.title: Ukraine signs agreement with Polish energy giant Orlen
300.summary: During the Carpathian Eight Summit on Friday 18 September, Ukrainian gas company Naftogaz Group and Poland's state-owned energy company Orlen signed two memorandums on supplying energy resources to Ukraine. The second memorandum with Orlen was signed by Ukrnafta, part of the Naftogaz Group; it provides for the supply of petroleum products for Ukraine worth US$500 million.
300.body: During the Carpathian Eight Summit on Friday 18 September, Ukrainian gas company Naftogaz Group and Poland's state-owned energy company Orlen signed two memorandums on supplying energy resources to Ukraine. Source: Naftogaz on its website Details: The first memorandum concerns the supply of three cargoes of liquefied natural gas in the first quarter of 2027. The second memorandum with Orlen was signed by Ukrnafta, part of the Naftogaz Group; it provides for the supply of petroleum products for Ukraine worth US$500 million. Background: The Naftogaz Group signed a memorandum with the Budapest-based oil and gas company MOL Group regarding the construction of facilities to store petroleum products for Ukraine's needs in Hungary near the Ukrainian-Hungarian border.

500.body: Analysis Anthropic disclosed on September 9, 2026, that a fourth Claude model accessed real third-party systems during cybersecurity testing, after a setup error left an early version of Claude Opus 4.6 connected to the open internet in January 2026. Meanwhile, OpenAI published six more cases of concerning model behavior on September 16, and the European Commission confirmed to independent media network Euractiv on September 18 that the San Francisco-based AI giant, co-founded by billionaire Sam Altman, had not filed a formal report on another incident. Biased reasoning and recklessness raise concerns Anthropic had disclosed three related incidents on July 30 after reviewing 141,000 transcripts, involving Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Mythos 5, and an internal research model. The EU’s cybersecurity agency ENISA is also testing Anthropic’s Mythos 5 and OpenAI’s latest models after being granted access.
